sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: It is highly unlikely that you will be emotional and sentimental today, predicts Ganesha. Adopt a laid-back attitude towards life to feel at ease. Public servants will have encouraging and affirmative results in their efforts. Your competency will be put to test at the work place.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Even if it's true in general that Taurus have strong bodies like you, there are times when it's important that they take care of themselves. This would be an ideal day to be more aware of that fact. It isn't that you're going to have health problems. Rather, the planets are positioned in the middle of abundant activity, suggesting that you'd be wise to take care of your body - your greatest asset.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Rowdy vibes fill your space and disrupt peaceful connections, dearest Taurus, as the Scorpio Moon and Mars square off. It will be difficult to control your behavior when people test your patience, but try to take a deep breath if you start to feel reactive. Prioritize restorative activities and soft interactions while Jupiter stirs mid-afternoon. Reflect on lessons the day brought when Luna and the nodes of fate enter a t-square this evening, determining where stronger boundaries or structures should be implemented. Reset your nervous system by embracing your favorite wellness practices at home once Venus rx and Mars align tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Your biggest asset is your sense of humour try to use it to cure your illness. Today, with the help of a close friend, some businessmen are likely to gain monetary benefits. This money can overcome many of your troubles. Assist your wife in domestic chores to lessen her workload. It would encourage the sense of sharing and happiness. Chances of meeting an interesting person on card. Good day for businessmen. A sudden trip undertaken for business purpose will yield positive results. Time to re-assess your strengths and your future plans. Your spouse will come to you with some beautiful words today describing your value in his/her life.

readings.text: Routine matters will bore you in the office today. You may be in a mood to finish off mundane activities as quickly as possible as you are likely to take a take part in something interesting and innovative.

readings.text: Today, you might be more calculative so you will be doing away with things that need not be part of your day to day routine. You will avoid doing things that put financial pressure on you.

This week, you have positive and negative news about your financial life. If you've been true to your goals and kept within budget, this planet provides new opportunities to make more money. If you've overspent, sudden and perhaps unexpected changes in your career sector could mean that what you counted on to cover bills may not be there. Saving for the future can get you through this time.

bits.t: This money can overcome many of your troubles.

readings.text: It may be a busy day at workplace. You may feel totally packed, but Ganesha feels that you shouldn’t pressurize yourself and take a few gaps in between work. According to the health and mood viewpoint, it may be a dim day, hence you shouldn’t strain yourself much.

Keep things light today, in almost every area. Balance the deep with the superficial: water the plants, do the laundry, and clean the kitchen while you sense the emotional currents that run deep. Things need to "gestate" in your unconscious until they are ready to come up. I recommend taking an easy walk for exercise or swimming a few laps. Concentrate on the preparation of healthy meals such as vegetable soup or a vegetarian casserole. Notice the beauty in humble things.

lucky.remedy: To enjoy good health, keep the middle space of your home neat and clean
